description: Source code for V4L2 frame rate control in media GPU module, managing video frame rate adjustments via ioctl calls and frame duration analysis.

classes.name: V4L2FrameRateControl
classes.description: Manages video frame rate control for V4L2 devices, adjusting frame rate based on frame duration analysis.

methods.name: UpdateFrameRate
methods.description: Adjusts the device frame rate based on moving average of frame durations.

methods.name: RecordFrameDurationThunk
methods.description: Static method to record frame duration, posts task if called from a different sequence.

methods.name: RecordFrameDuration
methods.description: Records the duration between frames and updates frame rate control accordingly.

methods.name: AttachToVideoFrame
methods.description: Attaches a destruction observer to a video frame to measure frame display durations.
